verdict.rationale: Pulumi's Automation API is documented as a programmatic interface for running Pulumi programs without the CLI. It lets you use the Pulumi engine as an SDK to create, update, configure, and destroy infrastructure from your own software. A community user independently calls it a 'killer Automation feature' for coding infrastructure migrations. Missing for 10: detailed hands-on corroboration of Automation API usage (e.g., per-language SDK coverage or production embedding reports) beyond a single community mention.
